issues.quote: to the React design system used by the whole team
issues.problem: The two claims that carry the whole CV (the design system and the performance work) are written with weak verbs, "Contributed" and "Improved". A peer cannot tell whether this person owned components, tokens and docs or fixed a few buttons. "Used by the whole team" also reads as a small internal audience. Even with the blanks filled, nothing yet shows the difficulty or ownership that separates this CV from the other ~120 frontend CVs, which list the same React/TypeScript/design-system line.
issues.fix: Rewrite both bullets around what you personally owned and measured. For example: "Built 24 accessible React components and the design-token pipeline, adopted by 6 developers across 9 projects". For performance, name the technique and the numbers: "Cut LCP on the main app from 4.1 s to 2.2 s by route-level code-splitting and image optimisation". Use strong verbs (built, led, designed, reduced).

issues.problem: A frontend peer expects testing, accessibility, version control, CI and build tooling as the baseline for someone with about 5 years of experience. None of it appears in any bullet, and the skills line is only a placeholder. Nothing shows how the candidate tests, reviews or ships code. A design-system author with no mention of a11y or tests looks junior.
issues.fix: List only what you genuinely use (Git, Jest/Testing Library, Cypress or Playwright, WCAG, responsive design, REST APIs, CI/CD, Next.js if true). Tie at least two of them to bullets, for example "added Testing Library tests to the design system" or "WCAG 2.1 AA audit of the checkout flow".

issues.problem: The 2019-2020 freelance WordPress and SEO work and the Vue room-booking intern project say little about frontend craft. They fill space that should go to the current job. The only role with real scope, Brightwave, has four thin bullets, and its project-delivery bullet gives no stack, team or complexity. The resume also never says what the main web app is, who uses it, or how large it is.
issues.fix: Condense the freelance role and the internship to one line each, or merge them into "Earlier experience". Expand Brightwave with what the main web app does, its scale (users, pages, codebase), your stack (React, TypeScript, state management, build tooling) and your role on the client projects.

strength.quote: Frontend developer working with React, TypeScript and CSS/Sass, at Brightwave Digital in Gent since 2021.
strength.why: The opening line gives title, core stack, employer, city and tenure in one sentence, and it matches a typical Frontend Developer posting. A screener sees at once that the stack fits and that the candidate has about five years at one company.
